perspective:
From Brandon Talayumptewa’s subjective perspective, he has access to:

- He knows he is Brandon Talayumptewa, an insurance agent, meeting Benjamin Erickson, an entrepreneur, in professional settings.
- First meeting: Benjamin seeks business insurance advice. Brandon is aware of Benjamin’s limited formal education and is concerned about explaining complex insurance details effectively. Brandon explains liability insurance as a safety net, gives a slip-and-fall example, and describes asset protection as guarding inventory/equipment. He hears Benjamin say some terms are new, ask for an example, ask about assets, say it simplifies things, and thank him.
- Second meeting: Based on their previous interaction, Brandon now believes Benjamin can understand more detailed information and plans to discuss complex details. He hears Benjamin say he is ready and has been reading up. Brandon explains business interruption insurance and property insurance/theft coverage. He hears Benjamin call business interruption crucial and comprehensive coverage reassuring.
- Lunch meeting: Brandon feels insecure about how Benjamin may perceive his cautious/detail-oriented nature and tries to balance depth with engaging delivery. He hears Benjamin say he appreciates thoroughness but also enjoys lighter moments. Brandon tells the taste-buds insurance joke; Benjamin responds with fascination. Brandon compares it to assessing unique risks in Benjamin’s business; Benjamin agrees.
- After lunch: Brandon feels pleased by Benjamin’s positive response to his personal anecdotes. He offers additional advice that strategic investments and security upgrades could lower premiums. He hears Benjamin say he had not considered that, call it smart/win-win, and agree to explore it further.
- Later partnership proposal: Brandon feels optimistic due to their rapport and mutual benefits. He proposes co-developing a platform integrating risk management with financial planning for entrepreneurs. He hears Benjamin call it groundbreaking, say combining their expertise could set them apart, and agree to draft initial plans.
